resources.string:
This app protects this phone if it is lost.

What it does, in plain terms:
• It reports to the owner's console whether the phone is locked and how many wrong unlock attempts have happened.
• If the owner marks the phone lost, it reports its location, as a map link, coordinates and Plus Code.
• The owner can lock the phone remotely, and erase it if this app is set as the device owner.

What it does not do, ever:
• It does not use the camera.
• It does not use the microphone.
• It does not read messages, contacts, browsing history or anything you copy.
